import sys, zlib, struct, json
p=sys.argv[1]; d=open(p,'rb').read()
assert d[:8]==b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
i=8; idat=b''
while i<len(d):
    L=struct.unpack('>I',d[i:i+4])[0]; t=d[i+4:i+8]; c=d[i+8:i+8+L]; i+=12+L
    if t==b'IHDR': w,h,bd,ct=struct.unpack('>IIBB',c[:10])
    elif t==b'IDAT': idat+=c
print('IHDR',w,h,bd,ct, file=sys.stderr)
bpp={2:3,6:4}[ct]; raw=zlib.decompress(idat); s=w*bpp
rows=[]; prev=bytearray(s); o=0
for y in range(h):
    f=raw[o]; o+=1; cur=bytearray(raw[o:o+s]); o+=s
    for x in range(s):
        a=cur[x-bpp] if x>=bpp else 0; b=prev[x]; cc=prev[x-bpp] if x>=bpp else 0
        if f==1: cur[x]=(cur[x]+a)&255
        elif f==2: cur[x]=(cur[x]+b)&255
        elif f==3: cur[x]=(cur[x]+((a+b)>>1))&255
        elif f==4:
            pp=a+b-cc; pa=abs(pp-a); pb=abs(pp-b); pc=abs(pp-cc)
            cur[x]=(cur[x]+(a if pa<=pb and pa<=pc else (b if pb<=pc else cc)))&255
    rows.append(bytes(cur)); prev=cur
def px(x,y): r=rows[y]; return tuple(r[x*bpp:x*bpp+3])
def lum(c):
    def ch(v):
        v/=255; return v/12.92 if v<=0.04045 else ((v+0.055)/1.055)**2.4
    r,g,b=map(ch,c); return .2126*r+.7152*g+.0722*b
def cr(a,b):
    la,lb=sorted([lum(a),lum(b)],reverse=True); return (la+.05)/(lb+.05)
def med(x0,y0,x1,y1):
    ps=sorted((px(x,y) for x in range(x0,x1) for y in range(y0,y1)),key=lum)
    return ps[len(ps)//2]
def extreme(x0,y0,x1,y1,dark=True):
    ps=sorted((px(x,y) for x in range(x0,x1) for y in range(y0,y1)),key=lum)
    k=max(1,len(ps)//50)
    sel=ps[:k] if dark else ps[-k:]
    return tuple(sum(c[i] for c in sel)//len(sel) for i in range(3))
hx=lambda c:'#%02X%02X%02X'%c
# spec: name, fg region (darkest 2%), bg region (median)
specs=json.loads(sys.argv[2])
for name,mode,fg,bg in specs:
    F=extreme(*fg,dark=(mode=='dark')) if mode in('dark','light') else med(*fg)
    B=med(*bg)
    print(f"{name:42s} fg {hx(F)} bg {hx(B)} ratio {cr(F,B):.2f}")
EOF

python3 -I - Onda/docs/design/reviews/assets/onda-concept-04-wonder-into-practice.png "$TMPDIR/onda-px/px.py" "$TMPDIR/onda-px" <<'EOF'
import sys,zlib,struct
src=open(sys.argv[2]).read().split("specs=json.loads")[0]; out=sys.argv[3]
sys.argv=[sys.argv[0],sys.argv[1]]; exec(src)
def save(fn,W,H,get):
    raw=b''.join(b'\x00'+bytes(v for x in range(W) for v in get(x,y)) for y in range(H))
    def ch(t,c): return struct.pack('>I',len(c))+t+c+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+c)&0xffffffff)
    open(fn,'wb').write(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+ch(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',W,H,8,2,0,0,0))+ch(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(raw))+ch(b'IEND',b''))
def crop(fn,x0,y0,x1,y1,scale=1):
    save(fn,(x1-x0)*scale,(y1-y0)*scale,lambda x,y:px(x0+x//scale,y0+y//scale))
def box(fn,x0,y0,x1,y1,W,H,up=1):
    sx=(x1-x0)/W; sy=(y1-y0)/H
    cache={}
    def avg(i,j):
        if (i,j) in cache: return cache[(i,j)]
        xs=range(int(x0+i*sx),max(int(x0+i*sx)+1,int(x0+(i+1)*sx))); ys=range(int(y0+j*sy),max(int(y0+j*sy)+1,int(y0+(j+1)*sy)))
        ps=[px(x,y) for x in xs for y in ys]; r=tuple(sum(p[k] for p in ps)//len(ps) for k in range(3)); cache[(i,j)]=r; return r
    save(fn,W*up,H*up,lambda x,y:avg(x//up,y//up))
crop(out+'/icon2x.png',420,30,630,270,2)
box(out+'/icon32x8.png',440,80,625,265,32,32,8)
box(out+'/icon16x8.png',440,80,625,265,16,16,8)
crop(out+'/people.png',0,480,560,960,2)
crop(out+'/phone3.png',1220,225,1500,815,2)
box(out+'/board_small.png',0,0,1536,1024,390,260,2)
EOF
